$comment: Toyota Supra JZA80 with a GM LS1 (Gen III, 24x) or LS3 (Gen IV, 58x). Researched 2026-09-29 for Swap Lab Phase 1 part 3b. Sources are vendor listings only (Sikky, Collins Performance Technologies, one reseller); no Toyota or GM document and no Supra install guide cover the swap, so every value is single-source. Prices are as listed on 2026-09-29, before options, in USD. Generic LS hardware (ECUs, standalone harnesses, T56/TR6060, clutches, generic pans, CD009 adapters) is researched separately and only named where a kit requires it. Not found: any adapter to keep the W58, V160 or V161; any JZA80-specific LS wiring harness, radiator or power-steering kit; any vendor besides Sikky with a complete JZA80 LS mount kit. Merged 2026-09-29 with the hardware common to every LS swap (GM PCM, Chevrolet Performance and Holley ECU routes, standalone harnesses, GM and Tremec gearboxes, clutches, fuel regulators), which a separate research pass sourced; those parts repeat in each LS swap file until Phase 3 moves them into parts/.
appliesTo: Every JZA80 (1993-2002; JDM, US and European; LHD and RHD). Sikky says its Supra mounts and oil pan fit both LHD and RHD. The kits replace the W58, V160/V161 or A340E with a GM T56, T56 Magnum or TR6060, or a Nissan CD009-family gearbox.

parts.notes: A used gearbox from a 350Z/370Z/G35/G37; no dated listing, so no price. Its own bellhousing is cut off and replaced by Collins' plate and a T56 LS bellhousing (see modifications). No kit keeps the Supra's own W58, V160 or V161.

modifications.value: Collins CD009 route: beat in the tunnel's stiffening flange at the crossmember location, at least 1/4 in on the top.

sources.title: Collins Performance Technologies: Lexus SC/LS/Supra to 350Z/370Z/VQ Crossmember Instructions
sources.note: 'you must beat in the sheet metal along the inner portion of the tunnel where this stiffing flange goes around the inside of the tunnel.' 'You need to beat it in at least' ... 'on the top but it is up to you how much room you want around the transmission.'

modifications.note: Written for the Collins Supra/SC crossmember with a 350Z/370Z gearbox.

modifications.value: Collins CD009 route: cut the bellhousing off the 350Z/370Z gearbox (replaced by the adapter plate and a T56 bellhousing).

sources.title: Collins Performance Technologies: Lexus SC400 SC300 Supra LSX Engine Using Nissan 350Z G35 CD009 CD00A Swap Kit (product page)
sources.note: 'Simply cut the existing bell housing off of the front of the Stock 350Z/370Z/VQ 6-Speed Transmission.'

modifications.value: Collins CD009 route: trim the floor sheet metal slightly for the shifter tripod.

sources.title: Collins Performance Technologies: Lexus SC400 SC300 Supra LSX Engine Using Nissan 350Z G35 CD009 CD00A Swap Kit (product page)
sources.note: '-Shifter (requires slight trimming of sheet metal for tri-pod to stick through)'

modifications.value: For the Sikky pan: trim the rear of the engine's factory oil baffle; aftermarket oil pumps may also need the windage tray, baffle and pan flange clearanced.

sources.title: Sikky: Oil Pan Install Guide PDF (linked from the Supra oil pan and Stage 1 pages)
sources.note: 'Remove factory baffle for trimming.' 'Cut marked area, grind all excess metal until all metal shavings are clean.'

sources.title: Sikky: Toyota Supra MKIV LS Swap Mid Sump Oil Pan (product page)
sources.note: 'Aftermarket oil pumps may require modification of the windage tray and baffle as well as adding additional clearance on the pan flange.'

modifications.note: Both are Sikky; the install guide is Sikky's general oil-pan guide, linked from the Supra pan page, and its dipstick-plug step may not apply because the Supra pan uses the LS3 dipstick tube.

notes: Keeping the Toyota gearbox: no LS-to-V160/V161 or LS-to-W58 adapter was found. Checked: Collins' catalogue (its W58 range covers Toyota engines only), XAT Racing (UZ-to-V160 and UZ-to-W58 only), SupraStore and two web searches. Advance Adapters' Toyota-truck-gearbox-to-GM bellhousing kit (712560, for the G52, G54, G85 and W56) says: This kit is not intended for use with any LS engine (polyperformance.com listing). Sikky's turn-key page prefers the 4L60E, T56 or T56 Magnum and handles the TR6060 or 4L80 on request. Factory pan: Collins says its Supra system was developed with the GM F-body (1998-2000 Camaro) pan, and Sikky's pan needs the F-body pickup tube 12558251. Steering and cooling: Sikky's turn-key page lists a Sikky Power steering line kit (car will retain functional power steering) in its Supra build, but no Supra power-steering line appears in Sikky's catalogue (store search, 2026-09-29), and no JZA80 LS radiator was found. Wiring Specialties' Supra harnesses are for the 1JZ only. The same Sikky turn-key page lists a Custom Sikky Genesis LSx Oil Pan in its base Supra package, which looks like text carried over from its Genesis page; the Supra pan OP005T is used here. The aftermarket MKIV power-steering lines found (PHR, Killswitch Motorsports, Suspicious Garage) are for the factory JZ pump, not a GM pump. CX Racing's LS kits found in search are for the MK3 Supra (MA70), and its site returned 403. Driftmotion lists no LS swap parts.
